proposals.before: On jisi the Empress Dowager had Zhu Jianshen, the regent's son, named crown prince.
proposals.after: On jisi the Empress Dowager had Zhu Jianshen, the emperor's son, named crown prince.
proposals.reason: Chinese 皇子見深 means the (captive) emperor Yingzong's son Zhu Jianshen, not the regent Prince of Cheng's son; the idiomatic 'regent's son' reverses the referent.

proposals.before: On jisi the Empress Dowager issued an edict establishing the Prince's son Jianshen as Crown Prince.
proposals.after: On jisi the Empress Dowager issued an edict establishing the imperial son Jianshen as Crown Prince.
proposals.reason: Chinese 皇子見深 is Yingzong's son; 'the Prince's son' wrongly ties Jianshen to the regent Prince of Cheng.

proposals.before: In the ninth month, on guimao, the Prince of Cheng took the throne as Emperor Jingtai, saluted the captive Yingzong as Retired Emperor from afar, declared the next year the first of Jingtai, proclaimed an amnesty, and cut field tax for Jingtai two by one-third.
proposals.after: In the ninth month, on guiwei, the Prince of Cheng took the throne as emperor, saluted the captive Yingzong as Retired Emperor from afar, declared the next year the first of Jingtai, proclaimed an amnesty, and cut field tax for Jingtai two by one-third.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao; also the text says he ascended as emperor and set the era name Jingtai, not that his personal title was already 'Emperor Jingtai'.

proposals.before: In the ninth month on guimao the Prince ascended the throne, honored the Emperor from afar as Retired Emperor, made the coming year Jingtai year one, proclaimed a general amnesty, and remitted one-third of the field tax of Jingtai year two.
proposals.after: In the ninth month on guiwei the Prince ascended the throne, honored the Emperor from afar as Retired Emperor, made the coming year Jingtai year one, proclaimed a general amnesty, and remitted one-third of the field tax of Jingtai year two.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei; both English fields wrongly write guimao.

proposals.before: On jiwei Wang Fu, right vice commissioner of the transmission office, and Zhao Rong, vice minister of rites, entered Esen's camp and were received by the Retired Emperor at Tucheng.
proposals.after: On jiwei Wang Fu, right vice commissioner of the transmission office, and Zhao Rong, vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, entered Esen's camp and were received by the Retired Emperor at Tucheng.
proposals.reason: Chinese 太常少卿 is vice minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices (Taichang), not the Ministry of Rites (禮部).

proposals.before: Toghon Taishi, khan of the Oirats, dispatched an embassy.
proposals.after: Toghtoa Bukha, khan of the Oirats, dispatched an embassy.
proposals.reason: Chinese 脫脫不花 is Toghtoa Bukha (Toqto'a-Buqa), the Oirat/Northern Yuan khan; Toghon Taishi (脫歡) was a different earlier Oirat leader (Esen's father).

proposals.before: The Oirat khan Toghon Taishi sent envoys.
proposals.after: The Oirat khan Toghtoa Bukha sent envoys.
proposals.reason: Chinese 脫脫不花 is Toghtoa Bukha, not Toghon Taishi.

proposals.before: In the eleventh month, on guimao, border fortifications along the frontier were rebuilt.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, border fortifications along the frontier were rebuilt.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

proposals.before: In the eleventh month on guimao frontier passes and barriers were repaired.
proposals.after: In the eleventh month on guiwei frontier passes and barriers were repaired.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

proposals.before: On yiwei Geng Jiuzhou, vice minister, settled refugees south of the capital and gave them three years without tax.
proposals.after: On yiwei Geng Jiuchou, vice minister, settled refugees in the southern metropolitan district and gave them three years without tax.
proposals.reason: Chinese 耿九疇 has 疇 chou, not zhou; 南畿 is the southern metropolitan district, not a personal place-name.

proposals.before: On guimao posted rewards promised safe return to subjects and troops held in enemy hands.
proposals.after: On guiwei posted rewards promised safe return to subjects and troops held in enemy hands.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

proposals.before: On guimao a reward schedule was posted to recruit civilians and soldiers trapped among the enemy.
proposals.after: On guiwei a reward schedule was posted to recruit civilians and soldiers trapped among the enemy.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

proposals.before: On gengshen overdue taxes and the summer assessment were forgiven in the capital region.
proposals.after: On guihai overdue taxes and the summer assessment were forgiven in the capital region.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸亥 is guihai, not gengshen.

proposals.before: On gengshen arrears of tax and summer levy within the metropolitan districts were remitted.
proposals.after: On guihai arrears of tax and summer levy within the metropolitan districts were remitted.
proposals.reason: Chinese 癸亥 is guihai, not gengshen.

proposals.before: On bingyin Hou Lin, vice minister, and Tian Li, deputy commander, inflicted a heavy defeat on the Guizhou Miao.
proposals.after: On bingyin Hou Jin, vice minister, and Tian Li, deputy commander, inflicted a heavy defeat on the Guizhou Miao.
proposals.reason: Chinese 侯璡 has given name 璡 jin; idiomatic Hou Lin mismatches the pinyin of 璡.

proposals.before: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, Hou Lin and Fang Ying broke the Guizhou Miao, seized their leader, and sent him to Beijing.
proposals.after: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, Hou Jin and Fang Ying broke the Guizhou Miao, seized their leader, and sent him to Beijing.
proposals.reason: Chinese 侯璡 has given name 璡 (jin); Hou Lin mismatches the character.

proposals.before: In the third month, on wuwu, Mao Shou campaigned against the Bama Miao in Huguang and defeated them.
proposals.after: In the third month, on wuwu, Mao Shoufu campaigned against the Bama Miao in Huguang and defeated them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 毛福壽 is Mao Shoufu; idiomatic shortens to Mao Shou.

proposals.before: In the fifth month of summer, on jiawu, Crown Prince Jian Shen was demoted to Prince of Yi and the Emperor's son Jianji was named crown prince.
proposals.after: In the fifth month of summer, on jiawu, Crown Prince Jianshen was demoted to Prince of Yi and the Emperor's son Jianji was named crown prince.
proposals.reason: Chinese 見深 is the given name Jianshen; splitting as Jian Shen is unnatural and obscures the personal name.

proposals.before: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Zhang Lun of the Ministry of Rites and Censor Zhong Tong, for begging that the Prince of Qi be restored as crown prince, were cast into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
proposals.after: In the fifth month, on jiazi, Zhang Lun of the Ministry of Rites and Censor Zhong Tong, for begging that the Prince of Yi be restored as crown prince, were cast into the Embroidered Uniform Guard prison.
proposals.reason: Chinese 沂王 is Prince of Yi (Yi Wang); idiomatic Prince of Qi mistranslates 沂.

proposals.before: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Liao Zhuang, Nanjing assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, was beaten at the palace gate for begging that the Prince of Qi be restored as crown prince; Zhang Lun and Zhong Tong were also flogged in prison, and Zhong Tong died.
proposals.after: In the eighth month, on gengshen, Liao Zhuang, Nanjing assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, was beaten at the palace gate for begging that the Prince of Yi be restored as crown prince; Zhang Lun and Zhong Tong were also flogged in prison, and Zhong Tong died.
proposals.reason: Chinese 沂王 is Prince of Yi; idiomatic Prince of Qi mistranslates 沂.

decisions.reason: 皇子 identifies Jianshen as the emperor's son; calling him the regent's son reverses the relationship at the center of the succession.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 皇太后詔立皇子見深為皇太子。

decisions.reason: The literal field must likewise render 皇子 as imperial son rather than the prince's son.
癸未 is guiwei, and 即皇帝位 states that the prince took the imperial throne before the new Jingtai era began.
The sexagenary day 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.
太常少卿 belongs to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, not the Ministry of Rites.
脫脫不花 names Toghtoa Bukha; Toghon Taishi was a different Oirat leader.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 脫脫不花者，故元後，韃靼長也。

decisions.reason: The literal field contains the same mistaken identification; 脫脫不花 is Toghtoa Bukha.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 脫脫不花者，故元後，韃靼長也。

decisions.reason: The sexagenary day 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 十一月癸未，修沿邊關隘。

decisions.reason: The literal field must also transliterate 癸未 as guiwei.
耿九疇 is Geng Jiuchou, and 南畿 denotes the southern metropolitan district.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 侍郎耿九疇撫安南畿流民

decisions.reason: The sexagenary day 癸未 is guiwei, not guimao.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 癸未，懸賞格招陷敵軍民。

decisions.reason: The literal field contains the same sexagenary-day error for 癸未.
癸亥 is guihai; the existing gengshen is a different sexagenary day.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 癸亥，免畿內逋賦及夏稅。

decisions.reason: The literal field must also transliterate 癸亥 as guihai.
The official's written name 侯璡 is Hou Jin; Hou Lin misreads the given-name character.
The same official is again written 侯璡, so his name should remain Hou Jin.

decisions.after: In the third month, on wuwu, Mao Fushou campaigned against the Bama Miao in Huguang and defeated them.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly restores the full name but reverses the given-name characters; 毛福壽 is Mao Fushou.
見深 is the single given name Jianshen and should not be split into two English words.
沂王 is Prince of Yi, not Prince of Qi.
The later reference uses the same title 沂王, Prince of Yi.
